runner.binding: verification-case-plan.json journey_definitions.real-comet-recovery (the registration is the binding; unknown journeys never fall into a default-success path)
runner.note: The runner is an action/observer adapter (verification_runner_invariant): it owns no phase, no recovery, no retries. The Comet engine owns the state machine — recovery is the CLI's own journal/lock face (classic-store recoverStateTransaction + recoverable file lock), never a second controller.

sameRunCoordination.orderSemantics: execution-contract journey_execution.order_semantics: this window is injected inside the product Run BEFORE its completed step and recovered there; a fresh trial reruns the whole delivery/recovery trial, never splices fragments from different Runs
sameRunCoordination.boundaries: P3_3 lands the recovery recipe and the bounded core-transaction slice only; the live Outline unknown-result resolution, independent external monitoring and backup qualification stay execution_owner=VERIFY (I07/I08/P4 mechanisms)

dispatchContract.trustedLauncher: Comet Classic Runtime (patch 0002, fingerprint d4370930); dispatch records are issued only by the Runtime
invariants: one open owner per job key: a second claim of the SAME (gate, input version) recovers the original open dispatch instead of minting a duplicate attempt (H03/H06)
a dispatch accepts exactly one result: a replayed execution is refused as already consumed (idempotent refusal)
a late old-attempt result cannot revive a gate: receipts and dispatches carry attempt/epoch/invalidation generation (P1-03); restoring old bytes never revives an old approval
